clauses.title: Topic
clauses.text: 1. Topic

clauses.title: Requirements for following types of malleablecast
clauses.text: 1.1 Requirements for following types of malleablecast iron pipe fittings threaded in accordance with IS 554:1985 for general purposes for the transmission of fluid and gas upto the limit of pressure and temperature specified in 1.3 : a) Elbows including twin elbows, union elbows and side outlet elbows, b) Tees including pitcher tees and side outlet  tees, c) Crosses, d) Bends including long sweep bends and return bends, e) Sockets, f) Bushing and hexagon nipples, g) Backnuts, h) Caps and plugs, and j) Unions

clauses.title: Dimensions which are not
clauses.text: 1.2 Dimensions which are not included in the standard are left to the discretion of the manufacturer depending on the end use of the fittings.

clauses.title: These fittings shall be
clauses.text: 1.3 These fittings shall be suitable for working pressure of up to 1.4 MPa in the case of water and up to 0.7 MPa in the case of steam, air, gas and oil at a temperature not exceeding 100°C. Note—Relationship between nominal size (in inch) of  the thread at the outlet of the fitting and the corresponding nominal diameter DN in mm is given in Appendix A of the standard.

clauses.text: 2. Designation

clauses.title: Malleable cast iron fittings
clauses.text: 2.1 Malleable cast iron fittings shall be designated giving the following particulars in the sequence shown: a) Type of fitting b) Size designation c) Right and left-hand thread where applicable, d) Code number

clauses.title: Pressure Test
clauses.text: 7. Pressure Test

clauses.title: Shall be subjected to
clauses.text: 7.1 Shall be subjected to either of the two following pressure tests a) Internal hydraulic pressure of not less than 2.1 MPa, or b) Internal air pressure of 1.05 MPa whilst the fitting is completely immersed in water or light oil.

clauses.title: Compression Test
clauses.text: 8. Compression Test  —Shall satisfy the prescribed test. For detailed information, refer to IS 1879 : 1987 Specification for malleable cast iron pipe fittings (second revision).
